sources.title: Annual statement of emissions for 2024 (accessible webpage)

facts.source_fact: The Annual Statement of Emissions for 2024 was published on 23 March 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach publication date to statutory carbon-account evidence.

facts.source_fact: The publication is the seventeenth annual statement required under section 16 of the Climate Change Act 2008.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve statutory-reporting provenance.

facts.source_fact: The statement reports greenhouse-gas emissions for 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the emissions year distinct from the publication year.

facts.source_fact: 2024 is the second year of the fourth carbon budget period covering 2023 to 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Attach carbon-budget period before evaluating progress.

facts.source_fact: The fourth carbon budget level is 1,950.0 million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent for 2023 to 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Use the legislated period cap rather than a parcel or annual limit.

facts.source_fact: The statement explains that the net UK carbon account must average below 390.0 million tCO2e each year for the fourth budget to be met.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the annual average as a period-level explanatory benchmark.

facts.source_fact: The statement is based on the latest final UK greenhouse-gas Accredited Official Statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Carry official-statistics provenance into carbon-account outputs.

facts.source_fact: Net UK emissions for 2024 are reported as 373.4 million tCO2e.
facts.expected_handling: Keep unit and reporting basis attached to the value.

facts.source_fact: The statement reports 2024 net greenhouse-gas emissions as 53 percent below the relevant base year.
facts.expected_handling: Do not convert the national reduction percentage into a local or parcel trend.

facts.source_fact: No adjustments for carbon-unit trading were made to the net UK carbon account in 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Record zero trading adjustment explicitly rather than assuming one.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 net UK carbon account is reported as 373.4 million tCO2e.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the statutory carbon-account label with the value.

facts.source_fact: For 2024 the net UK carbon account is equal to UK territorial emissions in the Accredited Official Statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Do not generalise this equality to other years without evidence.

facts.source_fact: UK emissions estimates are revised annually as new data, improved methods and international guidance are incorporated.
facts.expected_handling: Apply revision-vintage controls to historical comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 net UK carbon account will be revised in future Annual Statements of Emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Mark the account as subject to future revision.

facts.source_fact: Performance against the fourth carbon budget, including the 2024 account, will not be finalised until 2029.
facts.expected_handling: Do not label interim budget performance as final.

facts.source_fact: Climate Change Act emissions coverage is UK territorial coverage, including the statutory territorial scope specified by the Act.
facts.expected_handling: Apply territorial boundary before comparing with residence or consumption accounts.

facts.source_fact: The base year is 1990 for CO2, methane and nitrous oxide and 1995 for fluorinated gases.
facts.expected_handling: Use gas-specific base years when reproducing base-year comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The net UK carbon account is the metric compared against carbon budgets.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute another emissions accounting basis for the statutory metric.

facts.source_fact: The net UK carbon account must not exceed the carbon budget level at the end of the budgetary period.
facts.expected_handling: Evaluate compliance at the applicable budget-period boundary.

facts.source_fact: The underlying final 2024 UK greenhouse-gas estimates used by the statement were published on 5 February 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the underlying statistics vintage with the statutory statement.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the statutory source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach UK territorial, carbon-budget and gas boundary before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing statutory, residence and consumption accounts.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach emissions year, publication date and revision/finalisation status.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents interim values being treated as final.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry statement, official-statistics and carbon-account provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert national statutory carbon-account values into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
